column1: jrn_trigger: What was your main reason for wanting to buy sweet biscuits?
I had a craving for biscuits
It was part of my grocery shopping
I discovered I had run out
I was preparing a shopping list
I noticed it in store while I was shopping
I noticed a promotion on a leaflet from the store
I was making plans for what snacks were needed
I was asked to buy it by someone in my household
We had friends/family visiting our home
I needed to buy it for someone else
I had planned to visit someone
I saw it in the store newsletter/email
